comment: War (GDD 9.3; stage 4e, ADR 0021, decisions of 2026-11-07). Every war has a goal: land (a settlement of the enemy, named when war is declared), loot (the enemy's stores) or revenge (needs a cause: an attack, an aggression or a settlement of ours they hold). goals: victimPercent and witnessPercent say how strongly the victim and everyone who knows both sides remember the aggression (relations.json aggression). Score runs from -100 to 100: a fight won gives the winner's side scorePerWin, a settlement taken scorePerSettlement more. Weariness of a side (0..100) = years of war x wearinessPerYear + percent of the side's people killed in the war x wearinessPerLossPercent; at peaceAbove the side looks for peace at once; it lowers the mood of every settlement of the side by moodAtFullWeariness at 100 (effect war_weariness in effects.json). Peace terms: when the score is at least termsAboveScore, the loser hands over the settlement a war for land was about, or else pays a one-time ransom of ransomPercentPerScorePoint percent of every store per score point from termsAboveScore up (at most maxRansomPercent); a closer war ends in a white peace. cedeWorth: what a settlement handed over is worth in score points when a side weighs terms. Working values, to be tuned in stage 4e PR 5.
